profile.name: Muhammad Ahsan Nasir
profile.title: Unity Game Developer
profile.tagline: Turning ideas into polished, player-first games.
profile.bio: I'm a passionate Unity game developer who loves crafting immersive 2D and 3D experiences. From tight platformer mechanics to polished UI systems, I turn ideas into playable worlds that players remember.
profile.location: New Mirpur City, Azad Kashmir, Pakistan

resume.summary: Download my full resume or view a quick summary of my experience below.

experience.description: Developing mobile and PC game prototypes with Unity and C#, with a focus on responsive gameplay, clean systems, and player experience.

projects.title: ZigZag Run
projects.description: ZigZag Run is an exciting endless car game that challenges players to navigate a challenging and unpredictable road. Test your reflexes, control your vehicle carefully, and avoid falling off the edge as the road becomes increasingly difficult. How far can you go?

projects.title: Space Runner
projects.description: Endless runner with procedural levels, power-ups, and mobile touch controls.

projects.title: Dungeon Crawler
projects.description: Top-down roguelike with AI enemies, loot systems, and shader-based lighting.

projects.title: Neon Drift
projects.description: Arcade racing prototype with drift mechanics, neon visuals, and time-trial leaderboards.

projects.title: Puzzle Forge
projects.description: Grid-based puzzle game with crafting combos, level editor tools, and mobile-friendly UI.
